gate: Per readout: eight declared pairs; at least 75% both-endpoint contrast correctness and >=50% pooled full-vocab top1. Invariance prompts have same correct class and are not counterfactual competence tests.
selection: All formats and examples reported; no refitting H534 shared vectors.
sites: All modes at MLP12; shared and output_bias also at final residual.
output_bias: Mean unembedding rows for original class1 minus class0, normalized to frozen shared norm.
shared_readout_removed: Project shared vector off span of all original answer-token unembedding rows, then rescale to original norm. This only removes direct linear final-readout overlap, not nonlinear downstream effects.
precision: float32 computation, shared loader bfloat16-rounded weights
hypotheses: Frozen task writes transport to competent formats with disjoint output tokens.
Semantic orientation follows inverted questions using identical yes/no tokens.
Task writes exceed simple output-readout controls.
scope: Fresh prompts but familiar lexical items and deliberately constructed templates, not random population or model-training holdout.
